verdict.rationale: Docs confirm building blocks—PR-based code review (gitea-docs-3), CI/CD via Gitea Actions (gitea-docs-2), and permission/ACL management (gitea-docs-7)—but there is no explicit mention of branch protection rules, required status checks, or required-reviewer enforcement that would constitute standardized, customizable merge checks. missing for 10: explicit branch-protection/required-status-check documentation, evidence of customizable merge-rule configuration, independent confirmation that these checks are enforced before merge.
